method: Reverse-DCF by bisection: solve for the 10-yr FCF growth rate that makes (PV of 10 yrs + terminal at 2.5% / 10% discount + net cash) / shares equal the last close. Excludes pre-revenue and negative-FCF story names (Oklo, NuScale, IonQ, Rigetti, D-Wave, CoreWeave, Nebius, AST, Hertz) and banks/insurers, where FCF-based DCF is not meaningful.
